title: Advanced Nonlinear / Research Audit
purpose: Audit and bound nonlinear and research routes already present without adding physics, elements, or solver behavior.

included: existing nonlinear static and geometric nonlinear routes
existing transaction, retry, rollback, and failure diagnostics

provenance.evidence_head_policy: This audit document may be committed at a later evidence SHA; the execution source SHA identifies the audited code.
provenance.threshold_policy: No new numerical threshold was introduced or weakened in G10-LOT1. Existing owner-approved policies remain owned by their existing gates.

requirements.statement: Inventory each existing nonlinear/research route and its entry point.
Record element and material compatibility without inferring capability from code presence alone.
Audit residual, tangent, state, retry, rollback, and failure handling using existing contracts.
Audit determinism and finite-value behavior for the existing paths.
Preserve the existing G06/G07/G09 ownership and limitations.
Do not promote finite-kinematic J2 or coupled workflows without independent qualification.
Record external-correlation status and missing formulation-compatible evidence.
Provide a compact discriminating campaign without launching a release-scale campaign in Lot 1.
Keep a controlled provenance record with the audited source SHA and no numerical source changes.

cases.purpose: finite route tangent and state diagnostics

required_for_future_closeout: triple-coupling correlation only if it remains in the approved scope
not_claimed: external validation of arc-length branch selection

selected_routes.benchmark: Existing two-TET4 shallow-arch/snap-through branch with a turning point
selected_routes.reference: Code_Aster LONG_ARC deck and the independently reproducible bounded branch benchmark
selected_routes.acceptance_criteria: Use the existing G07 policy and declare all tolerances before execution; no new threshold is approved by this review.
selected_routes.scientific_reason: Branch selection and limit-point agreement are the unresolved evidence with the highest information value for this route.

selected_routes.benchmark: Same-mesh 3D Total-Lagrangian elastic structural case using the existing TET4/HEX8 scope
selected_routes.reference: Code_Aster Green-Lagrange comparison and CalculiX NLGEOM only when the measures and boundary/load model are equivalent
selected_routes.acceptance_criteria: Use the existing G07 policy and declare all tolerances before execution; non-comparable decks remain skipped.
selected_routes.scientific_reason: External evidence directly addresses the parked TL promotion blocker without changing the TL formulation.

not_selected.reason: The available Code_Aster J2 decks use small-strain PETIT and the available CalculiX J2 check is a small-strain material-point comparison; neither is an apples-to-apples finite-kinematic J2 oracle.
No formulation-compatible external deck is available; coupling a small-strain J2 deck to a TL elastic deck would conflate constitutive and kinematic differences.
The existing external contact comparisons use a different unilateral enforcement law or a non-equivalent surface model; they cannot provide a clean coupled correlation.
Triple coupling inherits the unresolved finite-kinematic J2 and contact-equivalence blockers, so an external campaign would not isolate a useful hypothesis.

qualified_bounded: nonlinear_static_small_strain within the existing G06 bounded scope
decision.next_step: Keep G07-owned Arc-Length and Total-Lagrangian promotion decisions separate; retain unqualified coupled routes as experimental or deferred.

limitations: Arc-Length and Total-Lagrangian evidence remains bounded research evidence owned by G07; G10 does not promote or close G07.
Finite-kinematic J2, J2-plus-geometry, coupled contact and triple coupling lack formulation-compatible external qualification.
The external HEX8 TL comparison is a matched-point comparison because the full QF instrumented path exceeded the bounded campaign budget.
No general physical validation, industrial-solver equivalence or exhaustive route-combination claim is made.
